$comment: Code-change A/B for the Q(U) droop regulation-delivery fix (finding #1):
monee scales a child's commanded q_mvar by regulation, so a curtailed PV
inverter delivered only q_cmd*regulation of the intended reactive. The fix
pre-divides the dispatched command by regulation so delivered Q == circle
target. Same binary is run twice (baseline code vs fixed code) on this
identical campaign; compare over-voltage residual and PV curtailment.
gen-priority curtailment is ON so PV generators are actually curtailed
(regulation<1) — otherwise the fix is a no-op. VVW on (default full circle).
name: qvfix_ab
